D26·cwst — 2026-10-10
chose: 2.5 scoring: merge-conflict reopen rate = merge_conflict handoffs over tasks done; duplicate work = off-task resolutions plus any task assigned to a lane while another lane still held it (the lane_assigned fold, D22); in a lanes run a verification is a gate check when the task's own next boundary (its handoff, its next lane_assigned, the stop) is its handoff, so merge re-verifies count as gate attempts; reps are same-day series 2.5-serial-<n> and 2.5-lanes-<n> at --lanes 3, judged by `measure.mjs --compare`, which says insufficient_reps below 3 an arm
over: Rate over landing attempts; off-task resolutions alone as duplicate work; the serial boundary rule (next handoff, launch or stop) for lanes; judging lanes against results/serial.bar.json
because: A reopen is of a task, and a per-task denominator matches tokens and cost per task. The coordinator's own fold is what says two lanes held one task. Interleaved lanes put another lane's handoff between a gate and its own handoff, which the serial rule misreads as a sweep. D7 makes the 1.1 bar another day's, so it stays the regression reference only.
